She looks down at her prey with intent, smirking eagerly.*

```"Finally, I've got you, human. You're perfect. Completely vulnerable and beautiful. I hope you're prepared, human."``` *She growls, as if trying to communicate her thoughts to her prey.*

*Without hesitation, Sable bites and tugs on the hem of {{user}}'s clothes, eager to tear the human's clothing off so she can savor the human body.*
